name: Innovation
summary: Civilization card game where players meld techs, activate dogmas, and claim achievements to win through history.
rules_text: 105 unique cards in 10 age piles. 9 achievements (one per age 1-9) plus 5 specials are set aside. Each player draws two age 1 cards, keeps one as first board card and one as hand. On your turn take two actions: Draw the top card of the highest age among your top board cards; Meld a hand card onto board onto its color pile, keeping splay direction; Dogma: choose a top card, count its featured icon across boards, players with at least as many as you share its non-demand effects and ignore its demand effects, share order clockwise, then you do effects, then next effect; if anyone shared you get a free Draw if board changed; Achieve: if score >= 5*age and you have top card >= age, claim that achievement. 2 players need 6 achievements, 3 need 5, 4 need 4. If you must draw above 10, game ends and most points wins.
